ai_summary: Here is a 2-3 sentence executive summary of the document:  Aarti Pharmalabs reported a robust Q1 FY27, achieving significant year-over-year growth with revenue up 42%, EBITDA up 40%, and PAT increasing by 49%, primarily driven by record sales in its Xanthine derivatives segment and the commercialization of new capacities. However, a key red flag is management's explicit statement that the high gross (56%) and EBITDA (25.4%) margins achieved in Q1 are unsustainable due to expected declines in Xanthine realizations, though volume increases and new facility ramp-ups are anticipated to maintain absolute gross margins while the API & Intermediate business faces ongoing pricing pressures and new facility pre-operative expenses will impact H2.
